canonicalQuery: How can I reduce LLM inference costs?

documents.title: Reducing inference costs for large language models
documents.text: Reduce LLM inference costs by serving fewer parameters per request, reusing the key-value cache, and routing simple prompts to smaller language models.

documents.title: Efficient LLM serving with quantization and batching
documents.text: Quantization, continuous batching, and prefix caching improve throughput and make large language model serving more efficient.

documents.title: Lowering the computational expense of neural text generation
documents.text: Compressing model weights and processing requests together can cut the resources required to generate text with neural networks.

documents.title: Training large language models efficiently
documents.text: Data parallelism, gradient checkpointing, and mixed precision reduce the memory and compute required during large language model training.

documents.title: GPU optimization for transformer inference
documents.text: Kernel fusion, optimized attention, and memory-aware scheduling improve GPU utilization when transformer models produce responses.

documents.title: How much does GPT inference cost?
documents.text: An analysis of per-token API prices, GPU time, and the operational cost of running GPT-style model inference.
